propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Munera tibi, Domine, nostrae devotionis offerimus: quae et pro tuorum tibi
grata sint honore justorum, et nobis salutaria, te miserante, reddantur. Per
Dominum.

translations.caution:
A pre-1955 lay hand missal, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its rubrics, its seasonal second and third orations, its Holy Week and its sanctoral are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n679, printed p. 671, heads 5 October `V. SS. PLACIDUS and COMPANIONS, mm.` and rubricates `All as in Mass IX. p. 479, except the Collect, Secret. and P. Comm. which are taken from Mass VIII. pp. 478, 479.` Mass VIII's Secret, on leaf n487, printed p. 479, carries no name and answers `Munera tibi, Domine, nostrae devotionis offerimus` word for word. Its Collect and Postcommunion carry `N. and N.` and the Postcommunion is ledgered untranslated. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.
